interventions.title: Street Furniture and Planters
interventions.description: Install benches, planters, or additional street trees in the wide sidewalk area to create a physical and psychological buffer from the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is high for the facility, a marked midblock crossing with curb extensions would improve safety.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a legal and visible crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to create a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for bike lanes or wider buffers.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk and Signage
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with pedestrian crossing warning signs to provide a safe path for bus riders.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the bus stop to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lower-height lighting along the walkway and at the bus stop to improve nighttime visibility and security.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a central refuge island to reduce exposure and provide a safe waiting area mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Street Trees
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planting strip along the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase the physical and psychological distance from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Furniture or Planters
interventions.description: Install street furniture, planters, or additional street trees to create a vertical buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer or street furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting trees on the near side of the street would provide shade and a vertical element to help slow traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Apply standard lane markings to organize traffic flow and narrow the perceived width of the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
